_nota: Resúmenes en inglés de la vitrina (hechos por Claude, derivados de cada acta y su NOTA); el acta en español y sus números mandan. `outcome` es MI lectura global de cada acta, no un campo del acta.

FB-005.title: The Conservation Loop (full run)
FB-005.summary: Sealed, not yet run: the full test of whether a conservation-of-mass check catches a hidden leak earlier than a manifest check, over 400 simulated runs per scenario.

FB-006.title: The Habitat Dreams
FB-006.summary: Sealed, not yet run: whether the daily shape of the habitat's consumption curves reveals a shared change in the crew's rest before the personal detector does.

FB-007.title: The Immune System
FB-007.summary: Sealed, not yet run: whether an error injected into the ledger is traced to at least 90 percent of the numbers it contaminates with under 5 percent false quarantine.

FB-008.title: Witness Demography
FB-008.summary: Sealed, not yet run: whether computing the manifest's uncertainty from each sensor's age beats using a fixed constant.

FB-005-D1.title: The Leak demo
FB-005-D1.summary: One simulated day with a 0.30 kilogram hidden leak and one control day. The manifest detector stays silent; the conservation law says the loop does not close. Prediction confirmed.

FB-009.title: The motor on real wearable data
FB-009.summary: Does the personal-baseline detector keep its promised false-alarm rate on real wearable data? Sleep: none in 97 windows. Pulse: 7 of 144 (4.9 percent), because daily pulse is autocorrelated.

FB-010.title: Whitening the pulse detector
FB-010.summary: Whitening the pulse series with an AR(1) filter lowered false alarms in sample, but the control also passed, so it could not be shown out of sample. A design flaw, published.

FB-011.title: Does a green keep its promise?
FB-011.summary: Does the power a green receipt declares hold on real data? Yes for sleep. My prediction that it would fail for pulse was refuted.

FB-012.title: Real household water demand
FB-012.summary: Real daily water use of 31 households in Utah: the day-to-day variability is large (median coefficient of variation 0.53). Autocorrelation and between-household correlation were inconclusive.

FB-013.title: Independent cohort validation
FB-013.summary: Does the pulse false-alarm problem replicate in another cohort and device? It did not (2 of 66). The whitening test was inconclusive; statistical power held at 89.4 percent.

FB-014.title: Solar storms, sleep and HRV
FB-014.summary: Is sleep or heart-rate variability related to geomagnetic activity (Kp) in 51 real people? No: the statistic fell inside the null. Small effects are not excluded.

FB-015.title: First replication of the 10 of 10 result
FB-015.summary: An independent replication of the earlier 10 of 10 detection result, with a prediction out of sample. Not replicated: the specification was wrong, and it is published as such.

FB-015-v2.title: Rebuilt replication of 10 of 10
FB-015-v2.summary: A rebuilt replication: 6 of 7 table cells reproduced, but detection reached 8 of 10, not 10 of 10. Documented, not replicated.

FB-016.title: Short sleep and tension
FB-016.summary: Two body-to-body cards on real data. Short sleep leads to tiredness: sustained (+7.9 points, 27 people). Tension leads to lower HRV: refuted (13 people, low power).

FB-017.title: Bone loss and the urine processor
FB-017.summary: A specification, not an analysis: bone-loss calcium could clog the ISS urine processor. No public mission-level data exist, so nothing was simulated.

FB-003R.title: Three witnesses
FB-003R.summary: Can three witnesses (world, sensor, human) tell who is wrong? Accuracy: world 1.00, sensor 0.88, human 0.91, nothing 0.83; the nothing case missed its target (0.83 below 0.85).

FB-004R.title: Slow water integrator
FB-004R.summary: Normalising a slow water detector by measured flow cut false alarms from 91 percent to 4.8 percent on real Utah flow, and detected a small drift 99.8 percent of the time.

FB-018.title: The Adversary
FB-018.summary: Is there an input that evades the CUSUM? Yes: a zigzag with the same mean and more variance is caught 1.8 percent of the time. The first variance detector reached only 67 percent.

FB-019.title: Detector or information limit?
FB-019.summary: Is the zigzag blind spot a detector problem or an information limit? Information: with a 14-day baseline even the best test catches 40 percent; with 28 days, 95 percent.

FB-020.title: Variance channel on real data
FB-020.summary: Does the variance channel work on real wearable series? It sees the zigzag (99 percent) but raised 9.0 percent false alarms, far above the 3 percent limit. Refuted; disabled for alarms.

FB-020-v2.title: Robust variance channel
FB-020-v2.summary: A robust variant (median absolute deviation) was fitted on one cohort and validated on another, but the validation had only 5 windows: inconclusive. Needs more independent data.

FB-021.title: Alarm with a false-alarm guarantee (e-process)
FB-021.summary: On real wearable data the textbook guarantee fails: asked for 1% false alarms, the raw method gave 5%. Calibrating it fixes the false alarms but costs sensitivity (99% to 71% at 2σ). The out-of-sample check had only 5 windows: inconclusive. The method is not ours; the measured gap between theory and real data is the result.
